output.name: cartnudge
output.tagline: Shopify upsells driven by what's in the cart — no popups, +9.4% AOV
output.description: cartnudge boosts AOV with native in-cart and post-purchase upsells on Shopify. Offers are basket-aware, built from order history, and install in one click — no theme edits. Flat $19/mo, no revenue share.
output.first_comment: I built cartnudge because Shopify merchants are stuck between popup spam and revenue-share pricing that eats into margins. Our pilot cohort of 60 stores saw +9.4% AOV on average, and we've earned a 5.0-star rating from our first 22 App Store reviews. What makes cartnudge different: offers render natively in the cart (no popups), we use your store's order history to suggest relevant upsells, and pricing is a flat $19/month — no % fees. We're Shopify-only for now, and don't yet support A/B testing, but we're focused on making the core experience bulletproof. Would love feedback on the offer logic and whether the flat pricing feels fair for your volume.
